# Christ Apostolic Church North America (CACNA)

> CACNA is the regional body uniting Christ Apostolic Church member churches across the United States and Canada, organized into 16 DCCs (District Church Councils) / Zones, each led by a Zonal Superintendent. Everyone is welcome — one family, many homes.

## About
- Full name: Christ Apostolic Church North America (CACNA)
- Address (CAC Village / Annual Convention site): 14051 Stahley Road, Blue Ridge Summit, PA 17214, USA
- Regional Superintendent: Pastor Dr. T.O. Agbeja
- Structure: 16 DCCs/Zones across the United States and Canada, each with its own member churches and Zonal Superintendent
- Languages: English, Yoruba
